# Zynth - Cloudflare SaaS Template

Fullstack template for building SaaS apps on Cloudflare Workers.

## Stack
- API: Hono (Cloudflare Workers)
- Frontend: React 19 + TanStack Router
- Database: Drizzle ORM + D1 (SQLite)
- Auth: Better Auth
- UI: shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS
- Deploy: Alchemy (infrastructure-as-code)

## Quick Start
```bash
bunx create-zynth-app my-app
cd my-app
bun dev
```

## Commands
- `bun dev` — Start local development
- `bun deploy` — Deploy to Cloudflare
- `bun run build` — Build for production

## Key Files
- `packages/config/src/index.ts` — App configuration (name, domains, features)
- `apps/api/src/routes/` — API endpoints
- `apps/api/src/db/schema/` — Database tables
- `apps/web/src/routes/` — Frontend pages
- `.env` — Environment variables

## Architecture
- Service bindings connect web worker to API worker (zero network latency)
- Type-safe RPC calls via Hono client (no manual fetch)
- Background jobs via Cloudflare Queues
- File storage via R2
